research_summary: Bounded distinct-related-output research on 2024 Water Resources Research Great Lakes ice forecast paper. The live publisher's Data Availability Statement names existing public GFS, FVCOM-CICE, GLCFS, CoastWatch, U.S. National Ice Center, and NOAA meteorological data. No separately released project-generated dataset/software with a distinct persistent identity was established in inspected evidence. Existing article explicitly acknowledges WPO JTTI NA22OAR4590188; this is funding of seed article, not proof of a separate related output. No novel artifact URL was identified requiring a same-mission primary REACH artifact URL gate. REACH comparison-cache exact DOI string search returned no match; do not treat this as proof of absence. No original DOI decision or public handoff.
